summary: Scanner beep now honestly reflects master-list membership, regardless of Non-Master Allowed setting
user_reported_bug: After uploading master AND enabling Non-Master Allowed, every scan beeps valid — should beep invalid for barcodes not in master. Also: when master is empty and Non-Master Allowed is on, all scans should beep valid.
root_cause: ScanItems.jsx beep logic used result.success (which is true whenever the item is added, including non-master adds when allowNonMasterProducts is ON). It never consulted whether the barcode was actually in master. Also, addTempItem/showQtyPopup did not differentiate the 'master empty' case from 'product not found in non-empty master'.
fix: Exposed masterProducts from useApp() in ScanItems.jsx for length check.

In addTempItem: new derivation -> isValid = (product found) OR (masterProducts.length === 0). Allow-list check now also bypasses when master is empty (treat as valid). masterProducts added to useCallback deps.
Mirrored the same logic in showQtyPopup (Punching Mode); returns isValid in result.

Switched 4 beep call-sites from playSound(true/result.success) to playSound(result.isValid) / playSound(result.success && result.isValid): handleHardwareScan default path, manual-entry-off scanner path, confirmQuantityPopup (Punching Mode add), and handleScan (manual Enter).

scenarios_verified_via_logic_trace.master_has_products + allowNonMaster=ON: INVALID beep, item still added, non-master visual
scenarios_verified_via_logic_trace.master_empty + allowNonMaster=ON + any_b: valid beep (no master to validate against)
scenarios_verified_via_logic_trace.master_has_products + allowNonMaster=OFF: invalid beep + reject error toast (existing behaviour)
scenarios_verified_via_logic_trace.master_empty + allowNonMaster=OFF + any_: valid beep + add (existing fallthrough, now consistent)

next_actions: On-device verification: upload master with a few SKUs, enable Non-Master Allowed, scan a non-master barcode → should hear invalid beep but item should appear in list. Then clear master and scan again → valid beep on every scan.
